text: Alyahuuda no lamndo maa an Nulaaɗo, nde jippin- taa e dow maɓɓe Deftere immorde ka kammu won ɓe lamndornoo Muusaa. Ɗum ko maande e goon-ngugol maaɗa, wata a mawnin fii ɗum e maɓɓe, gomɗii adinooɓe ɓe lamndinoke Muusaa ko ɓuri ɗum mawnude ; ɓe lamndino mo nde o hollata ɓe Alla e kene pettan. Lepte ɗen faɗɗini ɓe, hooti Alla Wuurni ɓe, ɓe rewi ngaari ndin ko woori Alla ɓaawo nde Aayeeje Ɓannguɗe ɗen ari e maɓɓe tinndingol gootaagu Alla ngun. Hooti Men Yawtani ɓe Men Okki Muusaa hujja ɓannguɗo e yimɓe makko ɓen.
